sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: simple traditional fat. This gives butter a cleaner identity than heavily processed fat substitutes. Very strong culinary usefulness. Butter has real kitchen legitimacy and practical use that matters in this category. Can fit as a moderate traditional fat. The editorial position here is that butter belongs as a flawed but legitimate middle-ground fat rather than a bottom-tier industrial product.
